title: The punctured matching projection has principal-power-torsion kernel
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $C$ its maximal-ideal completion, and $U\subseteq\operatorname{Spec} A$ the complement of the closed point. Let $q:Y\to U$ and $s:E\to\operatorname{Spec} C$ be finite morphisms, and let $D$ be completion overlap data, with its matching ring $B$, base map $b:A\to B$, model map $m:\operatorname{Spec} B\to\operatorname{Spec} A$, and punctured comparison $p:Y\to m^{-1}(U)$, all as in [def-sbc-punctured-completion-matching-sections]. Fix $f\in A$ with $D(f)\subseteq U$. Put $W=(m|_U)^{-1}((U\to\operatorname{Spec} A)^{-1}(D(f)))$ and $j:W\to\operatorname{Spec} B$ the composite of the two open inclusions. Let $\rho:B\to\Gamma(W,\mathcal O)$ be the composite of the inverse affine global-section isomorphism with $j^*$, and $\psi:\Gamma(W,\mathcal O)\to\Gamma(p^{-1}(W),\mathcal O)$ the pullback under $p|_W$. For every $x\in B$ such that $\psi(\rho(x))=0$, there exists $n\in\mathbb N$ with $b(f)^n x=0$.

source.place: Tag 0BLH, proof, affine charts and matching algebra; Tag 05ER, proof, localized chart comparison using Tags 05EP and 05EQ. Read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0BLH and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/05ER.

proof.text: Since the closed point is not in D(f), f belongs to the maximal ideal. Choose a finite generating family of that ideal and append f. As in the proof of 0BLH, use the affine inverse images under q of these principal opens and the affine scheme E. The overlap isomorphism D.overlapIso identifies the completed localizations with the completed chart algebras and gives the overlap cocycle.

Apply the sheaf equalizer on the finite principal-open cover of Y. A compatible tuple of chart sections is uniquely a section on Y; compatibility with the section on E is exactly the defining equality of the ring pullback B. This identifies the formal-gluing module H0 with the underlying module of B. Under this identification the f-chart projection is psi composed with rho, by appTop functoriality and the Spec–Γ adjunction, and multiplication by f is multiplication by b(f).

Apply the injectivity of the formal-gluing localized projection to the image of x/1: its f-coordinate vanishes, so x/1=0. The module localization zero criterion gives a power f^n killing x, hence b(f)^n*x=0. Concretely the overlap equations make the completed coordinate and every chart coordinate zero after localizing at f; take the maximum of their finitely many annihilating exponents. For f=0 use n=1, and for nilpotent f use any exponent annihilating f.

lean.statement:
theorem puncturedMatching_chart_kernel_torsion
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    {U : (Spec (.of A)).Opens}
    (hU : ∀ x : Spec (.of A), x ∈ U ↔ x ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint A)
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {q : Y ⟶ U.toScheme} [IsFinite q]
    {E : Scheme.{u}} {s : E ⟶ Spec
      (.of (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A))} [IsFinite s]
    (D : CompletionGluingData A U q E s) (f : A)
    (hf : (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f : (Spec (.of A)).Opens) ≤ U) :
    let W := (D.modelMap ∣_ U) ⁻¹ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f)
    let ρ := ((ΓSpecIso D.matchingRing).inv ≫
      (W.ι ≫ (D.modelMap ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).appTop).hom
    let ψ := (D.puncturedMap ∣_ W).appTop.hom
    ∀ b : D.matchingRing, ψ (ρ b) = 0 →
      ∃ n : ℕ, D.baseMap.hom f ^ n * b = 0
